reading_guide.NOT_APPLICABLE / SKIPPED: not run, with the reason recorded; no OS evidence is invented
reading_guide.OBSERVATION_SAME/OBSERVATION_DIFFERS: documented producer behaviour without an expectation; not caller readiness
reading_guide.REGRESSED_MET_TO_NOT_MET: met earlier, not met from 'changed_at': needs review
reading_guide.UNCHANGED_MET: met in every source (positive control or behaviour the findings do not touch)
reading_guide.UNCHANGED_NOT_MET: not met in any source: a remaining limit or an expectation no source provides (never a pass)
